payload.description: Review and merge C-4 (catalog gap measurement on pilot-000). This PR uses F-0's cached reader text — no new model runs required. Its merge closes the catalog coverage evidence gap and unblocks R-2 recommendation work. The unknown-spine rate it produces is the primary open question about whether the OC36 recall tradeoff is working.

Confirm whether the daily-blog.yml pipeline failure (opened 2026-11-01) is resolved or still active. The Nov 2 article merged successfully but the alert issue remains open. Close the issue if resolved; file a fix PR if not. This is a precondition for the next generation run.

Make an explicit call on the seven DRAFT review-only PRs open since 2026-10-27: merge, close, or park to a named phase. Without a recorded disposition these accumulate drift and consume triage attention in every subsequent roadmap pulse.

draftContext.markdown:
C-4 (BookcaseDiscovery #27) is the active gate: it measures ISFDB catalog coverage against F-0's cached reader text with no new model runs, and its merge is the stated prerequisite before R-2 recommendation work begins. The unknown-spine rate from pilot-000 is the most consequential open number in the pipeline — it determines whether the OC36 recall tradeoff is acceptable or needs revisiting before R-2 is scoped.

daily-logger #516 (daily-blog.yml pipeline alert) is an unresolved evidence gap: the Nov 2 article merged successfully but the alert issue remains open. Confirming whether the pipeline failure is resolved or still active is a precondition for the next generation run. Owner should confirm and close or document.

daily-logger #524 and #515 (independent review drafts for Nov 2 and Oct 31 articles) each carry findings requiring owner acknowledgement before acceptance. Neither is operative until reviewed and stamped through the editorial workflow.

daily-logger #522 (fixture/live-corpus collision) has no fix PR filed. The recovery path is currently manual.

workstation-yuri #4–#10: seven DRAFT review-only PRs with no in-window activity since 2026-10-27. Owner disposition needed: merge, close, or park to a named phase. Current state is drift accumulation with no recorded gate.

core #572 (fix: ground eli facts, DRAFT since 2026-10-27): correctness fix for the eli skill. No stated blocker or owner gate recorded; DRAFT status indicates not yet ready for merge review.

Evidence gaps not resolvable from available context: (1) actual unknown-spine rate from Q-1 failure-pattern analysis on pilot-000 — this is the headline missing number; (2) test coverage on the model judgment layer specifically, as the 647 tests are confirmed to cover contracts, ledger, and catalog parsing but judgment-layer coverage is not independently verified; (3) whether the ISFDB parser has any schema-version pinning or format-change detection; (4) whether the SQLite WAL ledger choice has a filed ADR or written rationale beyond workstation-local convenience; (5) daily-blog.yml pipeline status post #520 merge.
